description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- fix(listener): resume locally recorded work after a process restart [LET-12476] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4444
- fix(teleport): send runtime reminders as user messages by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4448
- chore: bump version to 0.32.10 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4449
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.32.9...v0.32.10
